initiatives.title: Fund the Plateau First
initiatives.summary: Before a single Ridgeline tower goes up, fully fund and front-load HB-14's Title III Just-Transition Fund — retraining, bridge wages, and tax-base backfill for the plateau coal counties. Build trust by funding first.

responses.body: I took this initiative's demand straight into Title IV: cap the ratepayer cost and fund the plateau's transition before construction. The signatures here are the constituency behind that amendment — and the reason HB-14 could pass at all.
